auto_context.card: This is an archived co-op gameplay livestream uploaded on January 7, 2021, from the channel of Korone (戌神ころね), a VTuber from hololive Gamers. She is playing the co-op action-adventure game A Way Out together with fellow hololive VTuber Sakura Miko (さくらみこ); the pair's combined nickname is "Mikkoro-ne" (みっころね), which is also the stream's tag. The stream is a continuation of a previous session, and the two are playing through the game's prison-break and fugitive storyline. Speech throughout is casual Japanese between the two performers, with the lively, comedic tone typical of hololive gaming streams.
